question: For each instance virtual machine state, show the VM state and compute the average, range, and variance of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that are not deleted, that have a non-empty network_info cache entry, and that are running on host "blaze8-12". Do not return any rounded answers.

    i.vm_state,
    AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb,
    MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS range_memory_mb,
    VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS variance_memory_mb
FROM instances AS i
WHERE i.deleted = 0
  AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM instance_info_caches AS iic
    WHERE iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
      AND iic.network_info IS NOT NULL
      AND iic.network_info <> ''
  )
GROUP BY i.vm_state;
